physical_policy.principle: Physical qualification is a fixed scenario checklist, not an open-ended subjective review.
blocking_scenarios: selection chrome logical size and DPR crispness at 50/100/200/400%
mouse/touch/pen handle acquisition using frozen visual/hit geometry
move/resize/rotate/cancel with no visible commit jump or stale chrome
slow/fast pan, wheel/pinch zoom, zoomAt anchor, 50/100/200 presets, fit document/selection
snap engage/release hysteresis and guide continuity under deterministic traces
G4.5 Pen + Laser coexistence with editing overlay

forbidden_authority_expansion: No lowering of A/B automated obligations based on physical feel.
